api.notConfigured: Puzzle service is not configured. Contact the site maintainer.
api.network: Cannot connect to the puzzle service. Check your connection or retry later.
api.timeout: Puzzle service connection timed out. Retry.

service.recognitionDisabled: Recognition is not enabled for this puzzle
service.solveDisabled: Solving is not enabled for this puzzle
service.uploadBusy: Too many simultaneous uploads. Retry later.

balloon.imageUndecodable: Image unreadable, unsupported or over 20 megapixels. Try another image.
balloon.timeout: Recognition timed out. Try a clear, complete screenshot.
balloon.processFailed: Recognition service failed. Retry later or use a clearer screenshot.
balloon.invalidResult: Invalid recognition result. Retry later or use a clearer screenshot.
balloon.boardNotReset: Could not confirm a reset board. Check that no balloons are already placed.
balloon.boardAlreadyPlaced: Balloons are already placed. Reset the puzzle in the game before taking a new screenshot.
balloon.boardNotFound: Board not found. Use a clear, complete screenshot before placing any balloons.
balloon.cellsUnconfirmed: Cells without a detected border remain uncertain. Check blocked and usable cells.
balloon.codeLowConfidence: Code confidence is below 0.95, so it was not used for the catalog. Use a clearer screenshot for code reuse.
balloon.stockRegionMissing: Complete stock area not found. Check lift and count values in a new screenshot.
balloon.stockRowsUnreliable: Stock rows could not be reliably located. Use a clearer stock screenshot.
balloon.stockIconsUnclear: Stock icons are unclear. Check each recognized lift and count.
balloon.stockMissing: No stock recognized. Use a screenshot containing all stock.
balloon.stockTotalMismatch: Stock counts conflict with the target lift. The least confident count was left blank; check all stock.
balloon.stockPartial: Some stock digits or badges are unclear. The target lift cannot uniquely determine the missing values.
balloon.liftConflictText: Stock row {{row}}: lift text conflicts with its icon. The lift was left blank; check it.
balloon.liftConflictIcon: Stock row {{row}}: icon conflicts with lift text. The lift was left blank; check it.
balloon.derived: Uniquely inferred from target lift {{target}}: lift {{lift}} × count {{count}}. Check the values.
balloon.derivedCount: Stock row {{row}} count was missing. Uniquely inferred from target {{target}}: lift {{lift}} × {{count}}. Check it.
balloon.derivedLift: Stock row {{row}} lift was missing. Uniquely inferred from target {{target}}: lift {{lift}} × {{count}}. Check it.
balloon.derivedRow: Stock row {{row}} lift and count were missing. Uniquely inferred from target {{target}}: lift {{lift}} × {{count}}. Check it.

circuit.imageUndecodable: Image empty, unreadable, unsupported or over 20 megapixels.
circuit.timeout: Recognition timed out. Retry with a clear, complete screenshot.

catalog.notFound: No complete puzzle recorded for this code.
catalog.invalidCodeBalloon: Invalid code: use WL-A + four digits, e.g. WL-A1001.
catalog.invalidCodeCircuit: Invalid code: use V + five digits or WL + four digits, e.g. V40020 or WL0020.
catalog.unavailable: Catalog temporarily unavailable. Retry later or use a screenshot.
catalog.circuitUnavailable: Circuit catalog temporarily unavailable. Retry later or use a screenshot.
catalog.circuitDbConnect: Cannot connect to circuit catalog database
catalog.readBack: Cannot read back the saved catalog record
catalog.circuitReadBack: Cannot read back the saved circuit catalog record
catalog.circuitReadBackAgain: Cannot read back the circuit catalog record
catalog.balloonUnavailableIssue: Catalog unavailable: code {{code}} was not queried or recorded. Continuing with screenshot recognition.
catalog.circuitUnavailableIssue: Circuit catalog unavailable: code {{code}} was not queried or recorded. Continuing with screenshot recognition.
catalog.incompleteNoRecord: Screenshot puzzle incomplete and no complete record for {{code}}. Use a complete screenshot.
catalog.incompleteSingle: Screenshot puzzle incomplete; {{code}} has one complete catalog puzzle available to solve.
catalog.incompleteMultiple: Screenshot puzzle incomplete and {{code}} has different records. Check and select a candidate.
catalog.verificationFailed: Recognized puzzle: {{reason}}. Not saved under {{code}}; use a clearer screenshot or existing candidate.
catalog.circuitVerificationFailed: Recognized puzzle: {{reason}}. Not saved under {{code}}; recognition result kept for diagnosis.
catalog.circuitReviewInvalid: The verification answer failed independent validation; not saved under {{code}}.
catalog.duplicate: This screenshot's puzzle under {{code}} was already recorded; not counted again.
catalog.differentPuzzle: {{code}} already has another puzzle. This one was saved separately without overwriting; check and choose.
catalog.upgraded: {{code}} confirmed by a second distinct screenshot; record upgraded to confirmed.
catalog.firstRecord: Complete puzzle for {{code}} recorded once; awaiting a second distinct screenshot.
catalog.circuitNoRecord: Screenshot puzzle incomplete and {{code}} has no record. Upload a complete screenshot.
catalog.circuitSingleCandidate: Screenshot puzzle incomplete; {{code}} has one catalog candidate you can select to solve.
catalog.circuitMultipleCandidates: Screenshot puzzle incomplete; {{code}} has valid variants. Check before choosing.
catalog.circuitDifferentFingerprint: This image was previously recorded under another puzzle fingerprint for {{code}}. Original history kept unchanged.
catalog.circuitVariantConfirmed: This variant of {{code}} confirmed by a second distinct screenshot.
catalog.circuitVariantFirstRecord: New valid variant of {{code}} recorded once; awaiting a second distinct screenshot.

puzzle.limitsInvalid: Catalog puzzle conflicts with board or balloon limits; cannot solve.
puzzle.boardUnreliable: Board recognition unreliable. Use a clear screenshot with the whole board and all stock.

puzzle.stockIncomplete: Balloon stock digits incomplete. Use a clear screenshot with the whole board and all stock.
puzzle.stockMismatch: Recognized stock conflicts with the board or target lift. Use another clear screenshot.

worker.phaseBasePlan: Finding a base build with low forging requirements
worker.phaseSearching: Finding builds with {{size}} stats at {{target}} together
worker.noteResident: Permanent stats only: all available breakthroughs and ability nodes maxed at this level; max-level weapon; no teammates, food or triggered combat effects.
worker.noteMerge: Gear combinations with equal stat contributions are merged. Found multi-stat builds are prioritized; globally lowest development cost is not guaranteed.
worker.noteTruncated: Search did not exhaust all combinations. No result does not mean no solution; reduce required stats or adjust limits and retry.
